desc: Identify that valid grids correspond to nonincreasing row lengths and reduce the problem to sparse interval feasibility on constrained rows.

Implement and test the row-length interval feasibility solution in Python: parse stdin, aggregate per row L = max black y and U = min white y-1, sort constrained rows, compute suffix maxima of L from bottom to top, output No if any suffix maximum exceeds the row's U, otherwise Yes; verify on samples and edge cases.
